plainName: Rent paid without house rent allowance
summary: If you pay rent for the home you live in and receive no house rent allowance, the rent is deducted to the extent it exceeds a share of your total income, within a monthly limit and a larger share of your total income, whichever is less. Total income here is before this deduction. You must file the declaration the Rules prescribe, and you may not own a home where you live or work, or an occupied home elsewhere valued as your own residence. Only the old regime allows it.

routes.name: Rent for your own residence
routes.description: The rent beyond the share of total income, within the lesser limit.

disqualifiers.description: Rent paid is not deducted in the default regime.
House rent allowance was received in the year.
